description: A Python library for extracting structured information from unstructured text using LLMs with precise source grounding and interactive visualization.

latest_release.name: v1.7.2
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- Support `google-genai` 3.0, which replaced `httpx` with `httpx2`, so Gemini retries transient network errors again (#605).
- Escape extraction data embedded in `visualize()` output (#573) and declare a UTF-8 charset in visualization HTML (#466).
- Route `gpt-6` model IDs to the OpenAI provider (#599) and send `max_output_tokens` as `max_completion_tokens` to OpenAI (#600).
- Stop `dict_to_annotated_document` from mutating its input (#577), load annotated documents saved with `null` extractions (#584), and retokenize a `Document` after its `text` changes (#583).
- Preserve literal strings such as `NA` and `NULL` when loading CSV datasets (#556).
- Apply explicit `temperature` consistently in `extract()` (#571) and skip empty extraction values that cannot be grounded (#567).
- Fix URL fetching and file encoding in documentation and examples (#550, #572).
- Add a pull request security check, harden CI workflows, pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs, and update live API tests (CI only; #566, #569, #594, #595, #601, #606).

## Compatibility notes

- Requests to `api.openai.com` (including regional `*.api.openai.com` endpoints) now send `max_output_tokens` as `max_completion_tokens`. Other `base_url` endpoints still receive `max_tokens` (#600).
- An explicit `extract(temperature=...)` now overrides a `temperature` in `language_model_params` or `config.provider_kwargs`, and is forwarded when `config` is used. With a pre-built `model`, it is ignored with a warning (#571).
- CSV dataset loading now keeps values such as `"NA"`, `"NULL"`, and empty fields as strings instead of reading them as missing (`NaN`) values (#556).
- Empty or whitespace-only extraction values are now skipped instead of producing ungrounded extractions (#567).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/google/langextract/compare/v1.7.1...v1.7.2

It processes materials such as clinical notes or reports, identifying and organizing key details while ensuring the extracted data corresponds to the source text.
